title: AGENTS.md without the questions
summary: Cleanup asked you 9 questions because the skill has two policies: do not touch a rule, and change nothing before a yes. Research and a five-seat panel led to this design: Joycraft fixes everything that is not a rule with no question; one time for each project it shows one list of the rules it keeps and the text it moves or removes, and waits for one yes; one silent check tells a session when the file needs work. All seven decisions are answered. The brief is decomposed into eight specs. Full verdict: docs/research/2026-11-17-entry-file-sota-panel-verdict.md.
